matched_variant_raw.title: GeoSQA open-ended question - engineering factors
matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text:
There is a “swallowing and spitting” relationship between a tributary of a certain large river and the main stream. The following figure shows the annual net runoff volume (the difference between output runoff volume and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport volume (the difference between output sediment volume and input sediment volume) at the outlet of this tributary from 1970 to 2000.

<image1>

Since 1983, the annual net sediment transport volume has generally shown a downward trend. What engineering construction in the basin of this tributary is this change most likely to reflect?

The following figure shows the annual net runoff volume (the difference between output runoff volume and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport volume (the difference between output sediment volume and input sediment volume) at the outlet of this tributary from 1970 to 2000. <image1> Since 1983, the annual net sediment transport volume has generally shown a downward trend. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 1970–2000, the left axis indicates annual net runoff volume, and the right axis indicates annual net sediment transport volume. The dashed line indicates annual net sediment transport volume, the dotted line indicates annual net runoff volume, and the solid line is the multi-year average value. Around 1970–1983, the annual net sediment transport volume had relatively large fluctuations; after 1983, the overall position of the dashed line tended to lower, showing an overall decline in annual net sediment transport volume. At the same time, the annual net runoff volume indicated by the dotted line still has obvious interannual fluctuations, and relatively high values also appear in the later period, and it does not show the same continuous downward trend as the annual net sediment transport volume. Reasoning: The question requires judging the “engineering construction” reflected by this change. If it were only that the climate became drier, causing less water and less sediment, the runoff volume would usually also decline continuously at the same time; but in the figure the net runoff volume has not declined in the same way, while the net sediment transport volume has decreased significantly, indicating that it is more likely that an engineering project capable of intercepting sediment appeared within the basin. After a reservoir is built, it will impound water flow, causing sediment to deposit in the reservoir area, thereby reducing the sediment transport volume downstream or at the outlet. Therefore, the overall decline in annual net sediment transport volume since 1983 most likely reflects that reservoirs were built in the basin of this tributary.

raw_record.question_text:
There is a “swallowing and spitting” relationship between a tributary of a certain large river and the main stream. The following figure shows the annual net runoff volume (the difference between output runoff volume and input runoff) and annual net sediment transport volume (the difference between output sediment volume and input sediment volume) at the outlet of this tributary from 1970 to 2000.

<image1>

Since 1983, the annual net sediment transport volume has generally shown a downward trend. What engineering construction in the basin of this tributary is this change most likely to reflect?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中1983年前后两类指标的变化：确认年净输沙量自1983年后总体下降，而年净径流量没有相同的持续下降趋势。再结合题干要求回答“工程建设”，判断不是单纯气候导致水少沙少，而是有能拦沙的水利工程。依据水库拦蓄径流并促使泥沙沉积、减少下游输沙的地理规律，得出该支流流域最可能兴建了水库。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中横轴为1970—2000年，左轴表示年净径流量，右轴表示年净输沙量。虚线表示年净输沙量，点线表示年净径流量，实线为多年平均值。1970—1983年前后，年净输沙量有较大波动；1983年以后，虚线整体位置趋于降低，表现为年净输沙量总体下降。与此同时，点线表示的年净径流量仍有明显年际波动，后期还出现较高值，并没有表现出与年净输沙量相同的持续下降趋势。
推理：题目要求判断这种变化反映的“工程建设”。如果只是气候变干导致水少沙少，通常径流量也会同步持续下降；但图中净径流量没有同样下降，而净输沙量明显减少，说明更可能是流域内出现了能拦截泥沙的工程。水库建成后会拦蓄水流，使泥沙在库区沉积，从而减少下游或出口处的输沙量。因此，1983年以来年净输沙量总体下降最可能反映该支流流域兴建了水库。
